title: Tempo Partnership
summary: Infinite joins the Tempo ecosystem as an infrastructure partner for stablecoin payments and compliance.

# Tempo Partnership


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


December 9, 2025


·


1 min read


We're joining the Tempo ecosystem as an infrastructure partner.


Global money movement is still broken: multi-day settlement, opaque fees, and high-friction compliance.


Stablecoins only improve global commerce if enterprises can actually adopt them compliantly.


We're here to help merchant developers in the Tempo ecosystem go live with global stablecoin payments and compliance in days, not weeks, through compliance and ramp orchestration.


If you’re a business exploring stablecoins or[Tempo](https://tempo.xyz/ecosystem) to move money onchain,[reach out to learn more](https://infinite.net/book-a-demo?intent=book-demo&from=%2Fblog%2Ftempo-partnership) .
